scope: This completed composition only. The separate f48 native dynamic-cache 432-episode cohort is not rerun or attributed to this source.

acceptance.complete_cost_accounting_scope: Declared bridge build, shared offline build/training/proof/calibration, and actual per-policy service wall times. Parent interpreter startup/imports and final report output require separate composition outer receipts.
acceptance.reason: Three repetitions are exploratory, never an application-wide or statistical net-benefit theorem.

controls.exact_dp_quality_upper_bound: Native cannot improve a correctly solved same-information deterministic scalar model; any incremental value must come from measured end-to-end cost or a richer model.

full_cost_application.invalidation_scope: Actual caller retires the old epoch before invoking the planner; action.invalidated is therefore empty. Three retained native-policy retirement receipts explicitly say epoch invalidation; all report zero remaining loader-mapped bytes.
full_cost_application.dp_gap_scope: Nine evaluated native requests, all selected complete finite-model witnesses equal the reported same-information exact minimum. The other 27 native-policy steps were not invoked; their native model gaps remain null. This is not actual runtime regret or machine-code global optimality.
full_cost_application.solver_cost_scope: Native search/request/projection clocks are actual subintervals of online decisions. Per-policy decision wall includes the full controller, not an isolated exact-DP solver. Pure exact-DP solve time is not inferred from calibration estimates.
full_cost_application.future_cost_scope: Selected witnesses contain future invoke/skip, gate, search, transport, preparation, proof, retirement, residency and closing costs in the supplied finite forecast. Full frontier witnesses are retained in original episode files; forecast optimality does not imply clairvoyance or optimal actual execution.

frozen_training.preparation_scope: complete already-built artifact identity check, dlopen transport and initial mapping observation; not compilation
frozen_training.samples_are_admission_domain: finite observed native cases, not an all-input theorem

refusal_recovery.scope: native model-level rejection of verified=false, then valid request on same process; independent verifier remains separate

shared_cost_policy.charged_per_arm: one full shared offline campaign cost plus sum of actual service walls; no unreported amortization
shared_cost_policy.cost_scope: Declared bridge build, shared offline build/training/proof/calibration, and actual per-policy service wall times. Parent interpreter startup/imports and final report output require separate composition outer receipts.
shared_cost_policy.limits: Shared offline calibration includes native calibration for every arm as an identical workload-information campaign; bridge build is additional only for native. No fully cold host claim.

outer_cost_completion.allocation_rule: Every policy pays the full common campaign remainder once; native additionally pays outer minus inner bridge build. Original nested report is retained unchanged.

hia_compilation_scope.external_abi: scalar-only C functions; resource and multiple-result functions are internal
runtime_assumptions: Linux LP64 target with 64-bit pointers and size_t
C calloc returns null or an initialized nonaliasing allocation of the requested size
C malloc returns null or a fresh nonaliasing allocation of the requested size; bytes are initialized before read or remain unobserved
C free accepts a live allocation from calloc or malloc, or null
abort terminates execution; no cleanup after traps is promised
native compiler, linker, loader, libc and host hardware are trusted

build_cost.scope: build() entry through pinned-source extraction, staging, Cargo, source/tool/binary validation and receipt preparation; excludes final receipt write, Python imports and caller startup
build_cost.status: observed successful source-preserving build; compiler stream identities retained

inner_alternative_allocations.rule: each standalone arm charged the same entire B once, not B/4; per-call B/744

outer_cost_completion.allocation_rule: Each descriptive standalone service pays the complete observed outer build, its service, and all common caller/registration remainder once.

raw_service.statistical_scope: one fixed 31-round service campaign; descriptive only, no population or independent-host claim

cost_scope: All listed command clocks and lane costs are nested in composition outer. Do not add subintervals or alternative standalone allocations to actual command wall. Historical acquisition, human engineering, energy and complete lifecycle costs remain unobserved.
